name: primekg
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/IXA7BM, latest version 2.1: kg.csv streamed to disk, sha256 and md5 measured while streaming, md5 checked against the Dataverse record, then converted once to parquet by DuckDB read_csv(all_varchar=true, RFC-4180 quoting).
citation: Chandak P, Huang K, Zitnik M. Building a knowledge graph to enable precision medicine. Sci Data 10, 67 (2023). PMID 36732524. doi:10.1038/s41597-023-01960-3

inputs.name: primekg-kg.csv
inputs.role: the knowledge graph the step-7 walk reads
inputs.sha256_scope: the kg.csv bytes: hashed while streaming, or re-read from disk (--reuse)

licence: CC0 1.0 (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0) as stated on the Dataverse record; the graph stays under build/ and is never committed (size, not terms).
patient_data: none. A public biomedical knowledge graph (diseases, genes, drugs, pathways, phenotypes). Nothing in it was derived from this case's callset or clinical record.
